purpose: Isolate whether delayed moving-average exits retain the large right tail better than the frozen 5 ATR target for the broad EMA30 15m launch surface.

owner_authorization.multivariable_bundle: Owner explicitly authorized autonomous parameter exploration in this conversation and specifically requested moving-average profit/stop management for large trends.

lineage.entry_economics_warning: The parent L2 failed its frozen validation. This experiment isolates exit mechanics; it cannot rehabilitate the entry edge by itself.

source.direct_15m_parity_rule: OHLC must match the prior complete 3x5m aggregation exactly on the overlapping 2026-01-01 through 2026-02-28 interval; volume tolerance is 1e-8.

selection.method: one deterministic coordinate pass; one factor changes per step
selection.score: median half-year mean net bp minus 0.5 times population standard deviation of half-year means

exit_semantics.trail: After a completed close arms the runner, update a monotone stop to MA minus direction times buffer ATR14; it can act from the next bar.
exit_semantics.close2: After arming, two consecutive completed closes beyond MA plus the adverse buffer trigger an exit at the next open.
exit_semantics.half_fixed3: Half exits at +3 ATR or the initial stop; half follows the selected runner. Gross returns are weighted 50/50 and one round-trip cost is charged.
exit_semantics.timeout: Close at the selected maximum-hold bar close.
exit_semantics.fixed_reference: Full position, 2 ATR stop, +5 ATR target, 96-bar timeout.
